decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single-storey rear extension to provide servicing area to shop premises, due to its size, position and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of Bell Parade and compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining occupiers. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) and S.4.7 (Access to Upper Floors). It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used as a service area ancillary to the retail use (Class A1) of the premises known as 2 Bell Parade, Bell Road
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to existing premises.
